chunks.head: at length
chunks.note: at length = 经过一段时间后终于;等于 at last。

literal.meaning_cn: 长度→(此处)一段时间之后

chunks.ex_en: At length the long meeting came to an end.
chunks.ex_cn: 终于,漫长的会议结束了。

chunks.head: stop short
chunks.note: stop short = 猛地停下;short 此处作副词'突然'。
chunks.ex_en: She stopped short when she heard her name.
chunks.ex_cn: 听到自己名字时她突然停住了。

chunks.head: on purpose
chunks.note: on purpose = 有意地,反义为 by accident。
chunks.ex_en: He broke the toy on purpose.

chunks.head: no less than
chunks.note: no less than + 数字,强调数量之多。
chunks.ex_en: No less than fifty people came to the party.
chunks.ex_cn: 多达五十人来参加聚会。

chunks.head: on shore
chunks.note: on shore = 在陆地上(相对于在海上/船上)。
chunks.ex_en: The sailors were glad to be on shore again.
chunks.ex_cn: 水手们很高兴又回到岸上。

chunks.head: shake off
chunks.note: shake off = 抖掉/摆脱(疾病、追赶者、烦恼等)。
chunks.ex_en: I can't shake off this cold.

chunks.head: fall into the hands of
chunks.note: fall into the hands of = 被某人(常为敌方)掌控。
chunks.ex_en: The letter must not fall into the hands of the enemy.
chunks.ex_cn: 这封信绝不能落入敌人之手。

chunks.head: to be sure
chunks.note: to be sure 作插入语,表'诚然、不可否认'。
chunks.ex_en: To be sure, the plan has some risks.
chunks.ex_cn: 诚然,这个计划有些风险。

chunks.head: in distress
chunks.note: in distress = 处于危难中(船只、飞机、人皆可)。
chunks.ex_en: The plane radioed that it was in distress.
chunks.ex_cn: 飞机发无线电说它遇险了。

chunks.head: presence of mind
chunks.note: presence of mind = 危急时保持冷静应对的能力。
chunks.ex_en: She had the presence of mind to call for help.

chunks.head: at hand
chunks.note: at hand = 就在近旁、随手可及。
chunks.ex_en: Keep a pen at hand while you read.

chunks.head: no doubt
chunks.note: no doubt = 想必、多半(表较强推测)。
chunks.ex_en: No doubt he will be late again.

chunks.head: clear up
chunks.note: clear up 指天气转晴;也可指'解决/澄清(问题)'。本章为放晴义。
chunks.ex_en: The sky cleared up after lunch.

chunks.head: carry away
chunks.note: carry away = 把…带走/冲走(水流、风等)。
chunks.ex_en: The strong river carried away the small boat.
chunks.ex_cn: 湍急的河水把小船冲走了。

chunks.head: give over
chunks.note: give over = 放弃、罢手;give 此处非'给'义。

chunks.head: set out
chunks.note: set out = 启程动身(去某地);set 此处非'放'义。
chunks.ex_en: We set out early the next morning.

chunks.head: take pains
chunks.note: 本章出处为分离式(take the pains with …),故 card-only。take pains (to do) = 用心去做。
chunks.ex_en: She took pains to make everyone feel welcome.
chunks.ex_cn: 她费尽心思让每个人都感到受欢迎。

chunks.head: lay up
chunks.note: 本章出处为分离式(laid it up),故 card-only。lay up = 储备、把…收存起来;lay 此处非'放'义。
chunks.ex_en: We lay up food for the winter.
